body: Confirmed in source before dc0b832a: SESSION-V0-017..019 appeared after the OCM selected section and 020..022 before it. Actual final session OCM had 16 rows despite 22 stable clauses. Expected all owning numbered requirements in denominator. Fixed in this owned integration by preserving clauses/IDs and grouping inside one Requirements section; independent doc review PASS and afd21 produces 22 session /119 aggregate obligations. Source fix integrated but native completion pending final dogfood/landing. Evidence /private/tmp/corvint-wow-manager/final-dogfood-before-denominator-repair.json and final-denominator-clean.log.

completion.reason: Fixed and integrated on main by e9546350 (Guard session handoff OCM denominator), merged in PR #454 (d761a403) on 2026-10-01, on top of the dc0b832a spec repair. Re-verified on 2026-10-08 at main 2a93b5a182966f72836cd28bf569dc44c0f5220c: TestSessionContextDividendSpecEnumeratesEveryObligation passes; it requires all 22 SESSION-V0 clauses inside the one Requirements section the OCM enumerator selects, and fails against the pre-dc0b832a spec (16 obligations). REQUIREMENTS.tsv locates all 22 SESSION-V0 IDs. The original integration recorded an independent doc review PASS and an actual OCM generation of 22 session obligations (ticket body). Evidence digests are the sha256 of the four cited files at that commit. NOT_RUN: make gate and a fresh independent review of this closeout. NOT_PRODUCED: new CEM, because no source changed. Manual completion because the integration predates this closeout.
